claims.claim: Direct Belgium Gearbox / Tokunbo, direct from Belgium
claims.evidence: No shipping documents, import tags, or origin markings visible in any photo; dirt/ground setting does not confirm provenance.
Witness could only identify it as a generic used transmission/gearbox assembly; no legible brand or model tag was read from the photos.
No video or clip of the unit running or being bench-tested; photos are static.
An audio claim; no sound clip or operating video is available to check for noise.
No odometer, VIN-linked history, or paperwork shown connecting mileage to this specific unit.
Bell housing and bolt heads are only partially visible; no close-up shows undisturbed torque-seal paint or factory seals on all fasteners.

risks.risk: Vehicle/engine fitment mismatch (wrong model or variant)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the stamped part/tag number (the '39' marking) matched against a Ford parts catalog
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified generic fitment, not guaranteed Expedition V8 4WD

risks.risk: Internal wear or damage to gears, clutch packs, seals, torque converter
risks.proof: Video of the unit being rotated/spun or bench-run, or a borescope/teardown photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst case, i.e. needing full internal rebuild

risks.risk: Fluid leaks from seals or housing
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seal areas and housing seams after wiping down for fresh residue

risks.risk: Missing or damaged sensors, connectors, bolts (incompleteness)
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set showing all mounting points, bolts, and connector pins
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, requiring replacement hardware

risks.risk: Corrosion/oxidation affecting internal electronics or contacts
risks.proof: Close-up of connector pins and sensor housings, cleaned, showing no corrosion
risks.if_unproven: priced as corroded/at risk of electrical failure

risks.risk: Undisclosed accident or flood history (origin claim unverifiable)
risks.proof: Bill of lading, import clearance papers, or photos of a VIN tag on the originating vehicle
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown origin, no premium for 'Tokunbo direct' claim

risks.risk: No warranty or return protection if claims are false
risks.proof: Written seller statement on return/warranty terms, screenshot of chat agreement
risks.if_unproven: priced as sold as-is, no recourse

proof_requests: Video of the gearbox being rotated by hand or bench-run to check for knocking/noise
Close-up photo of the stamped part number / tag for model verification
Close-up photos of all seals, housing seams, and bolt heads for leak/tamper check
Photos of all electrical connectors and sensors, cleaned, for corrosion check
Any import/shipping documentation or VIN tag showing Belgium origin and donor vehicle
Written confirmation of warranty or return policy
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a used transmission assembly, so a worst-case price can be set, but all of the seller's performance, origin, and fitment claims remain unverifiable from photos alone.
